physics-m3-q3.title: Roller coaster dị 2
physics-m3-q3.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-m3-q3.material: Roller coaster dị 2 kg malitere site n'izu ike n'ebe dị mita 20 n'elu ala n'ụzọ na-enweghị esemokwu. Gịnị bụ ume mmegharị ya n'oge ọ rutere n'ala? (Jiri g = 9.8 m/s²)

physics-m3-q4.title: Ọ bụrụ na ọsọ
physics-m3-q4.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-m3-q4.material: Ọ bụrụ na ọsọ ụgbọ ala n'okporo ụzọ abụọ okpukpu site na 50 km/h ruo 100 km/h, n'ihe dị ka ugboro ole ka ebe ọ na-eme ịkwụsị mgbe a na-akwụsị ike ga-abawanye n'echiche?
physics-m3-q4.s.s1.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na ọsọ ụgbọ ala n'okporo ụzọ abụọ okpukpu site na 50 km/h ruo 100 km/h, n'ihe dị ka ugboro ole ka ebe ọ na-eme ịkwụsị mgbe a na-akwụsị ike ga-abawanye n'echiche?

physics-killer-09.title: N'ime mmeghachi omume nuclear
physics-killer-09.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-09.material: N'ime mmeghachi omume nuclear fusion $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$, ibu akụkụ ọ bụla bụ $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neutron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. A na-eweta ume hà $1\,\mathrm{u}$ dị ka $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$, a na-eleghakwa ume mmegharị nke akụkụ tupu mmeghachi omume anya. Kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ume $E$ a wepụtara n'mmeghachi omume a, na ume mmegharị neutron nwere ma ọ bụrụ na e werere na ịdị ukwuu momentum nke $\mathrm{^4He}$ na neutron e mepụtara hà ma ntụnyere ibu ha bụ $4:1$?
physics-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: N'ime mmeghachi omume nuclear fusion $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$, ibu akụkụ ọ bụla bụ $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neutron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. A na-eweta ume hà $1\,\mathrm{u}$ dị ka $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$, a na-eleghakwa ume mmegharị nke akụkụ tupu mmeghachi omume anya. Kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ume $E$ a wepụtara n'mmeghachi omume a, na ume mmegharị neutron nwere ma ọ bụrụ na e werere na ịdị ukwuu momentum nke $\mathrm{^4He}$ na neutron e mepụtara hà ma ntụnyere ibu ha bụ $4:1$?
physics-killer-09.s.s1.explain: $\Delta m=5.0301-5.0101=0.0200\,\mathrm{u}$ yabụ $E=\Delta mc^2=0.0200\times930=18.6\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Mgbe mmeghachi omume, ịdị ukwuu momentum nke akụkụ abụọ hà, yabụ $K=\dfrac{p^2}{2m}\propto\dfrac1m$ ma $K_{He}:K_n=1:4$. Ya mere $K_n=\dfrac45\times18.6=14.88\approx14.9\,\mathrm{MeV}$, $K_{He}\approx3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Ọ bụrụ na e tụgharịrị ịdabere n'ibu n'ụzọ ntụgharị, $3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ②); ọ bụrụ na e kewaa ume n'ọkara, azịza na-ezighị ezi ③; ọ bụrụ na e gbakọọ $\Delta m$ n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi dị ka $0.0400\,\mathrm{u}$, azịza na-ezighị ezi ④.
physics-killer-09.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-09.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
